style: Instrumental electronic science fiction strategy game soundtrack in the musical world of Ben Prunty FTL and FTL Multiverse. Warm rounded analog lead, rippling FM plucks, a deep melodic synth bass and drifting string-synth pads; curious, wistful frontier travel. An evolving melodic instrumental with arpeggiated inner motion, subtle harmonic colour and clear phrasing. Exploration arrangement: spacious, reflective and curious. Soft detailed electronic percussion, a gently moving bass and delicate repeating synthesizer patterns support the expressive lead. The middle passage opens into lighter suspended textures before the developed theme returns. Intimate game underscore with room between phrases. Steady tempo throughout; the quiet bass pulse and small percussion stay precisely on the beat through the thinner passage, return and ending. Purely instrumental. Em, 104 BPM.
